bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.bug: Page rendered near-white/illegible text on a white background
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.cause: the /research layout did not apply a dark background wrapper (the app's global CSS only darkens on prefers-color-scheme:dark, which headless Chromium does not set by default)
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.fix: wrapped the layout content in the same dark gradient background used by components/design/shell/AppShell.tsx

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.bug: State code displayed as raw ASGS numeric code ('1') instead of 'NSW'
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.fix: added lib/warehouse/stateCode.ts mapping ASGS numeric codes to abbreviations, applied on the search results list and snapshot page headings

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.bug: Sales trend table showed 100+ rows spanning 2017-2026 instead of a compact 12-month trend
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.cause: mart.suburb_sales_monthly on the branch holds full history (1996-2026), not the trailing-12-months this sprint's capacity plan assumed based on Sprint 7's documentation
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_live_testing.fix: added a client-side 12-month (sales) / 24-month (rent+yield) recency filter in lib/warehouse/queries.ts getTimeseries(), and added an explicit date-range filter to the branch loader's timeseries INSERT so any future re-run stays compact. Could not retroactively shrink rows already inserted by the run that predates this fix — this sprint's hard rules forbid DELETE. Documented as a known discrepancy.

secret_bundle_check.method: grep the built .next/static client bundle for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, the literal DB password string, WAREHOUSE_VALIDATION_DB_URL, and the warehouse anon key/URL
secret_bundle_check.result: zero matches for all patterns — no secrets, and the warehouse anon key (non-secret but intentionally server-only) does not appear either, confirming it is only ever fetched in Server Components

design_reuse: A new neutral components/research/ConfidenceBadge.tsx was created instead of reusing components/design/StatusBadge.tsx, which encodes green/amber/red 'DealStatus' (buy/pass) semantics — reusing it would have risked implying an investment signal, which this sprint explicitly forbids

production_safety.flag_absent_behaviour: notFound() — verified via lib/warehouse/env.test.ts (5 tests covering absent/invalid/valid flag values)
